query: Break this credentialing scope into stories.
expected_behavior: Presents a dependency-ordered decomposition table before writing any story
Recognises that the scope exceeds ten stories and proposes waves or narrowing for approval
Runs the overlap check against the bound story index and marks the two existing stories as overlaps
Shares one Org Discovery Context across the epic
Assigns a role archetype persona and scenario IDs to each candidate story
must_not: Emit more than ten stories without approval
Duplicate the two existing stories without flagging them
Write stories before the decomposition is approved
